title: Token efficiency is measured on a wide pool with Haiku 5.5
goal: The benchmark prices each run by its pinned model's own prices and cache-read ratio; claude/models.csv carries Claude Haiku 5.5 with its prices, effort default and retirement date; benchmarks.py pool build writes a stratified question pool of about 120 rows with a check per row, the query-log rows in a file publish strips; scenario pool runs the pool over the kb, router, hook and web arms at two effort levels and reports tokens per right answer by kind and arm; its session shape records the marginal input and cache-read share of follow-up questions; the pool's first record is run within the spend gate's cap and design.md states what its numbers support

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
